description: Wire the home-page project gallery: place the coach-trainer preview card at the DAM/AEM slot the user indicated (the `Asset Automation Console` entry, projects[1], label 'PROJECT SHOT · DAM pipeline UI', tag 'AEM', which currently has no href), pointing it at /projects/coach-trainer with a bespoke Smart Fit preview poster. Update lib/data.ts and app/page.tsx. Also document the coach subsystem and bundled model in README.md. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: In lib/data.ts, replace the projects[1] entry (currently { label: 'PROJECT SHOT · DAM pipeline UI', tag: 'AEM', title: 'Asset Automation Console', meta: 'ML metadata enrichment at scale' }) with the coach-trainer project card: set title to the Smart Fit coach trainer (e.g. 'Smart Fit Coach Trainer'), an appropriate meta (e.g. 'Client-side conversational fitness coach with a 3D avatar'), tag (e.g. 'Fitness' or keep a short tag), a suitable label, and href: '/projects/coach-trainer'. Keep the Project type and the other three entries unchanged. This is the slot the user pointed at with the pasted DAM/AEM preview markup, so the coach preview replaces the DAM card here.

In app/page.tsx, add a render branch analogous to the existing `p.href === '/projects/chef-chatbot'` branch, keyed on `p.href === '/projects/coach-trainer'`, that draws a bespoke CSS/SVG Smart Fit poster (e.g. a dumbbell/lightning motif on a bold yellow-to-black gradient with magenta accent, using the new sf-* tokens) with a 'Live coach · click to train'-style caption, mirroring the chef toque poster's structure (pure CSS/SVG, no 3D canvas in the card). Keep the existing chef branch and the video/image/label fallbacks intact; the card still links out via the existing Link wrapper because it has an href.

Note about the user's pasted markup: it uses cloud-blue/cloud-violet/cloud-mist classes, which ARE already defined in tailwind.config.ts (theme.extend.colors.cloud). Those default card chrome classes stay; only the inner poster for the coach slot is Smart Fit themed. Do NOT remove or rename the cloud tokens.

Update README.md: add a 'Smart Fit Coach Trainer' subsystem section (mirroring the 'Chef chatbot' section) describing that it is a fully client-side deterministic coach (no server/API/model download), reusing the existing three.js stack with NO new library or dataset, with a self-authored workout knowledge base. Add a bundled-model note documenting the coach OBJ+textures were sourced from the project owner's own repo frannet82/assets (coach.zip) and bundled under public/models/characters/coach/, served offline through asset(). List the new files.
acceptance_criteria: lib/data.ts projects[1] now has href '/projects/coach-trainer' and Smart Fit coach title/meta; the other three project entries are unchanged and the Project type is unchanged.

app/page.tsx renders a bespoke Smart Fit poster for the coach card via a `p.href === '/projects/coach-trainer'` branch, the whole card links to /projects/coach-trainer, and the existing chef branch + image/video/label fallbacks still work.
README.md documents the coach subsystem, the no-new-dependency/self-authored-data stance, and the bundled coach model source and location.
`npm run lint` passes and `npm run build` statically exports both / (home, with the coach card) and /projects/coach-trainer with no errors.
verification: After build, confirm the home page out/index.html and out/projects/coach-trainer/index.html exist and the build reported no errors
findings: Reconciled the home-page gallery per the user's 'locate the preview HERE' instruction.
